title: Soundstage — Free Bootstrap 6 Band & Musician Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 band template — full-bleed stage hero, tracklist with a working play state, a tour list with sold-out shows struck through, video lightbox and merch.
yoastTitle: Soundstage — Free Bootstrap 6 Band & Musician Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 band and musician website template with a tracklist play state, tour dates, native dialog video lightbox, merch grid, mailing list and a full album page with a sticky pre-order rail.
intro: Soundstage is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for bands, solo musicians, DJs, labels and venues. It pairs a full artist homepage — release, tracklist, tour dates, videos, merch and a mailing list — with an album page carrying the complete tracklist, credits and a sticky pre-order rail.
note: Two decisions give this one its character. The tour list keeps sold-out shows on the page, struck through rather than removing them, because a sold-out show is evidence rather than an absence — and it is a real list, not a table, so it reflows properly on a phone. The tracklist has a genuine play/pause state wired up with only one track active at a time; no audio ships with the template, but the styling is real and there is an obvious place to attach an <audio> element. The video lightbox is a native <dialog>, so Escape, focus trapping and the top layer come from the browser rather than from JavaScript.
summary: Soundstage is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for bands, musicians and labels. The homepage runs a full-viewport gig-poster hero, an album block pairing sleeve art with an interactive tracklist, a tour list where sold-out shows stay visible and struck through, a video section opening a native dialog lightbox, a merch grid and a mailing-list signup. The album page adds the full eleven-track listing, sleeve notes, credits and a sticky formats-and-pre-order rail. Near-black canvas with one acid accent and oversized condensed type. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — artist homepage and a full album page
Tracklist with a real play/pause state, only one track active at a time
Tour list keeps sold-out shows visible and struck through rather than hiding them
Video lightbox built on a native <dialog> — Escape and focus trapping from the browser
Full-viewport gig-poster hero with a two-part scrim for legible white type
Merch grid and mailing-list signup with native :user-invalid validation
Sticky formats and pre-order rail on the album page
Gig-poster design language — near-black, one acid accent, oversized condensed type
Bootstrap 6 vendored at a pinned commit, ESM-only, no build step
